subject: Hospitality
title: Hybrid Events: The New Normal
description: A short lesson to help you apply Hybrid Events: The New Normal.

hook.text: Hybrid events serve in-person and virtual audiences simultaneously. Post-pandemic.

buildup.text: Hybrid requires dual production: a physical event PLUS a broadcast-quality stream with remote engagement tools, chat.

discovery.text: Virtual attendees pay 30–50% of in-person prices. The added audience extends reach while lower pricing reflects less experience.

twist.text: The 'hybrid tax' is real: running both formats costs 25–30% more than in-person alone.

climax.text: Successful hybrid events don't just stream the stage—they create separate, designed virtual experiences.

punchline.text: Two audiences, two productions, one brand. Hybrid done right doubles reach.

quiz.question: What is the 'hybrid tax' in events?
options: Running both in-person and virtual formats costs 25–30% more than in-person alone
